project.name: AirportXRCompanion
project.objective: Deliver a polished native iPhone companion for long-haul international, same-airport, and inter-airport layovers with provider-neutral live data, conservative sourced recommendations, accessible guidance, offline behavior, tests, simulator evidence, and a reproducible research report.

current_focus: AR guidance now derives straight, slight, standard, sharp, and U-turn instructions plus eight-way compass headings from terminal-graph geometry. Independent QA movement can be delivered either by loopback polling or through Apple Simulator Core Location using simctl location and CLLocationManager; the Core Location footprint is an explicit synthetic HND fixture and floor is graph-derived. The current app tree type-checks against the iOS Simulator SDK, scripts validate, the Core Location command dry-run passes, and the 47-page report was re-exported and visually inspected. Project-owned DerivedData was removed, leaving about 1.5 GiB free; a fresh Xcode build, new unit/UI tests, and simulator delivery remain blocked below the 5 GiB build floor.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The app supports ordered timezone-aware multi-leg itineraries, independent layovers, overnight/date-line trips, and the populated BKK-HND-LAX reference scenario.

Airport changes are detected automatically from a versioned multi-airport metro registry; HND to NRT is the complete reference transfer, mandatory transfer precedes optional visits, and a fastest claim requires complete current route evidence.

Every layover recommendation derives available and required time from sourced distributions; unknown or expired entry, queue, boarding-cutoff, or transfer facts stay unknown and prevent a positive city recommendation.

Preserve six roots—Journey, Flights, AR Guide, Map, Layover & Transit, Settings—and implement itinerary, in-flight/OCR, layover decision, facilities/hotel/work, entry, city feasibility, transfer, and calculation-trace flows.

The production architecture supports normalized flight, hotel, activity, facility, entry, transit, weather, and place providers through a secret-holding proxy or native frameworks, while every UI value is labeled live, cached, stale, demo, or unknown.

On-device predictive models may learn from user-owned outcomes and from live provider fields only when the exact provider contract/policy permits training; learning is versioned, attributable, disableable, erasable, and never learns entry rules or weakens the safety floor.
evidence: User correction: live data can also be learned, 2026-07-14
Earlier approved plan limits commercial payload training to contracts that explicitly permit it

acceptance_criteria.statement: Final acceptance requires a terminal build of the current generated project, deterministic automated tests passing, opt-in non-gating live contract tests, and a normal iPhone simulator launch with screenshot/log review; physical-device AR is reported separately.

Create Documentation/Reports/2026-07-14-airportxr-long-haul-layover.md and a deterministic Markdown/PDF/provenance trio under output/pdf/2026-07-14-airportxr-long-haul-layover, with rendered-page inspection, hashes, design rationale, evidence, validation, limitations, and reproduction steps.

UI decisions are based on relevant first-party industry research, documented with rationale and accessibility implications, and represented in editable Figma wireframes where the available plan permits.

constraints.statement: Modify only /Users/anony/Downloads/AirportXRCompanion; leave /Users/anony/Downloads/airborder and the supplied TransitSphere PDF untouched.
Create, build, test, and operate simulators from VS Code/terminal; do not open the Xcode graphical interface.

Never ship or log provider secrets. Worker secret names include AMADEUS_CLIENT_ID, AMADEUS_CLIENT_SECRET, optional FLIGHTAWARE_AEROAPI_KEY, SHERPA_API_KEY or Timatic credentials, GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY, TRANSITLAND_API_KEY, and GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY; the app receives only HTTPS proxy URLs through ignored Config/Secrets.xcconfig. MapKit needs no app key; native WeatherKit uses entitlement.
Entry guidance is informational and links to official verification; never promise admission, collect passport numbers/scans, or let an expired result authorize a city visit.
User preference or learned state may make plans more conservative but can never weaken deterministic safety, freshness, accessibility, entry, boarding, or return constraints.

Caching, persistence, redistribution, and training are field/provider specific and must follow a versioned policy and actual contract; Google Places remains ephemeral except where permitted, and visa/entry rules are never a learned model target.
Fabricated operational numbers exist only in named demo/test fixtures and are visibly distinguished from live facts; a demo route cannot be called current fastest.
Seatback OCR is local/offline by default and window-view geolocation is experimental only; neither may drive visa, boarding, city-safety, or navigation decisions without independent confirmation.
Hotel and activity booking remains an external deep link; no in-app payments. Day-room/transit-hotel claims require an explicit official/operator record.
Deterministic fixture tests are required CI; credential-gated live contract tests are opt-in, never log private payloads, and never gate CI.
Recheck at least 5 GB free before rebuilding; clean only AirportXRCompanion-owned build artifacts by default.

decisions.decision: Use global provider-neutral interfaces with HND as the fully populated reference airport and BKK-HND-LAX plus HND-NRT as named scenarios.
decisions.rationale: This proves the complete product flow without implying unsupported global facility completeness.
decisions.source: User-approved defaults and later HND-NRT addition, 2026-07-14

decisions.decision: Centralize deterministic policy at version layover-safety-2026-07-14-v1: safe when Wilson 95% lower bound is at least 0.90, not recommended when upper bound is below 0.70, otherwise tight; unresolved critical inputs require confirmation; use 10,000 trials for the approximately 9,604 worst-case precision derivation.
decisions.rationale: The thresholds are explicit, reproducible, reviewable, and conservative under uncertainty.

decisions.decision: Identical production snapshots derive a stable seed; live launches vary naturally; DEBUG QA stochastic mode uses an unseeded generated seed that is logged and replayable.
decisions.rationale: This separates reproducible decision logic from changing live context and enables exact bug replay.
decisions.source: User clarification about non-deterministic launches and approved plan, 2026-07-14

decisions.decision: Use Pareto filtering and lexicographic cost vectors for terminal and inter-airport routing instead of hidden scalar penalties.
decisions.rationale: Fastest, accessible, least-walking, simplest, and low-crowd tradeoffs remain inspectable rather than hidden in magic weights.

decisions.decision: Persisted personalization learns only from explicit user-owned outcomes; normalized live provider responses never train the model.
decisions.rationale: This was adopted to avoid unauthorized commercial-payload training and fabricated baselines.
decisions.source: Earlier implementation correction captured in attached text, 2026-07-14

decisions.decision: Permit on-device learning from live observations as well as user-owned outcomes when the exact provider/field policy explicitly permits training; preserve source/policy provenance, consent controls, disable/erase behavior, safety isolation, and the ban on learned entry rules.
decisions.rationale: Live data can improve failure resilience and recommendations, but authorization differs by provider and field and must remain enforceable.
decisions.source: Latest user correction: ‘it can learn from live data too’, 2026-07-14

decisions.decision: Use a versioned offline metro-airport registry for automatic transfer detection, sourced for airport codes from public-domain OurAirports while treating metro grouping as curated and travel times as provider-derived.
decisions.rationale: Airport-change detection must work offline without converting a geographic grouping into a fabricated journey duration.

decisions.decision: Use native MapKit POI discovery for nearby places and optional Amadeus for availability; keep official/operator records distinct from discovery and booking claims.
decisions.rationale: MapKit provides keyless native discovery while availability and facility access need different evidence.

decisions.decision: Lead task screens with the safest next action, consequence, deadline, data mode, and freshness; progressively disclose formulas/provider detail; retain native SwiftUI semantics and research-backed travel patterns.
decisions.rationale: Travel-day interfaces must reduce decision cost under stress without hiding uncertainty or provenance.
decisions.source: UI/UX research review and user request for design rationale, 2026-07-14

decisions.decision: Use local venue map point plus floor as the indoor-location boundary. Support in-app graph replay, independently clocked loopback polling, and an Apple Simulator Core Location QA transport. Core Location indoor QA is allowed only through the versioned synthetic HND transform; floor comes from the matched graph node. Accept venue IMDF positioning, beacon proximity, UWB, or surveyed visual anchors through future production adapters; keep ARKit camera-relative until a production venue transform exists.
decisions.rationale: Apple Core Location provides a realistic simulator delivery channel but latitude/longitude alone cannot identify an airport floor or corridor. The explicit QA transform exercises the app pipeline without presenting synthetic coordinates as surveyed airport geometry, while one local-coordinate reading shape keeps routing and AR provider-neutral.
decisions.source: User request and Apple primary-source indoor-location research, 2026-07-16

decisions.decision: Use one shared boarding-pass-style flight summary in Journey and Flights: flight/status, airport codes, separate endpoint-local times and short dates, city/terminal/gate, explicit day offset, then boarding time/gate/group.
decisions.rationale: This matches the information hierarchy documented by Apple Wallet and major airline day-of-travel apps while removing the ambiguous long cross-time-zone date sentence.
decisions.source: User redesign request and first-party airline/Apple research, 2026-07-16

workstreams.name: Policy-gated live learning
workstreams.truth: Learning is default-deny and dual-authorized by the bundled policy registry plus normalized source metadata for an exact purpose. Only live, non-demo flights with stable record IDs and resolved scheduled/actual departures train; refreshes are deterministically deduplicated; persistence keeps aggregate residuals and one-way IDs rather than raw provider payloads. Entry/visa has no training purpose. All current commercial policies deny training until a verified contract is recorded.
workstreams.next: Keep actual commercial policies denied unless an operator verifies the exact contractual use; include these targeted results in the later full-suite run and report.

workstreams.name: SwiftUI long-haul experience
workstreams.truth: The last verified build contains the six principal roots and long-haul flows. All synthetic movement paths are explicit UI-test-only. Physical-device AR and real venue positioning remain separate exercises.

risks.statement: Earlier full local verification gaps were closed by the synchronized build, unit, UI, Worker, dry-run, and simulator acceptance snapshot.
The transfer planner can select demo routes and TransitView can label that selection ‘Fastest’, violating the complete-current-evidence rule.
